resources.string: %1$s Settings
Agent
Hold Space for Action popup

Off by default. Replaces the Space long-press keyboard picker with Agent and up to 3 pinned local Acts. Hold, slide into a choice, release to preview only. Requires enabled Agent configuration; unavailable in private fields. Tap Space and pre-hold swipes are unchanged.
Hermes agent settings

Optional: only the prompt preview you explicitly send leaves this keyboard. Ordinary typing stays offline. Use a dedicated, least-privilege Hermes profile with tools disabled, never your main terminal-capable agent. Your server and model provider may retain prompts. See README for setup.
HTTPS API base URL (server root or profile prefix; omit /v1)
Bearer token (paste; hidden)

Token is never shown again. Paste a token to enable requests or change URL. To disable a saved opt-in, uncheck it and save without changing URL; no token needed. Stored encrypted with Android Keystore; excluded from backups.
Allow explicit Agent requests to this server
Save configuration
Disable and forget configuration
Close
Test saved connection
Tests SAVED configuration only. Unsaved URL, token and opt-in changes are not applied. Opening settings or saving never sends a test.
Saved opt-in is enabled. A test requires confirmation.
Test unavailable: no saved configuration. Save an HTTPS URL, bearer token and explicit opt-in first.
Test unavailable: saved opt-in is off. Paste a token, opt in and save first.
Test unavailable: saved configuration cannot be read. Unlock the device and check Keystore availability.

Send one test using SAVED configuration? Unsaved form changes are not applied. The saved bearer token is used only for authentication.

Exact fixed prompt:
%1$s

No editor contents, clipboard, form token, Acts or other private text are sent. The server/model may incur cost and retain this synthetic prompt. No retries. The response will not be displayed or inserted. Cancellation may not stop server work.
Send one saved-connection test
Testing saved connection (45 second UI limit). No response will be displayed or inserted. Close, uncheck opt-in, save or forget to cancel locally; server work may continue.

Diagnostic busy: the previous request or transport cleanup has not finished. No new test can be sent, even after reopening settings. Wait for cleanup; if the provider/transport will not return, force-stop this app to recover. No automatic retries. Server work may continue even after force-stop.
Test not sent. Confirm a new test to send the fixed prompt using saved configuration.
Test cancelled locally. Server work may continue and incur cost. Saved configuration is unchanged unless you save or forget.
Test not sent: saved configuration changed or became unavailable. Review saved settings and confirm a fresh test.
Success: saved connection returned a valid final answer. Response discarded; nothing displayed or inserted.
Authentication refused (HTTP 401/403). Check the saved API-server key and profile permissions.
Route not found (HTTP 404). Check the saved server-root URL and profile/proxy path; omit /v1.
Quota or rate limit (HTTP 429). Check server/provider usage limits before testing again.
Server/provider failure (HTTP 5xx). Check gateway and model/provider availability.
Unexpected HTTP status or redirect. Check the HTTPS API route; redirects are not followed.
TLS trust/handshake failed. Check the Android-trusted certificate and HTTPS configuration. No insecure bypass is available.
DNS lookup failed. Check the phone network, VPN/tailnet connection and saved hostname.

Test timed out (45 second UI limit; network timeouts may occur sooner). Check phone VPN/tailnet and server/model availability. Server work may continue. A new test is blocked until request and transport cleanup finish; if stuck, force-stop this app. No automatic retries; another confirmed test may incur cost.
Network connection failed. Check phone connectivity, VPN/tailnet and service availability.
No valid final answer. Expected one non-streaming assistant text answer with finish_reason stop; malformed, oversized, truncated and tool-only replies are refused.
Saved. Use Agent in the expanded keyboard toolbar.
Disabled; configuration deleted.
Not saved. Check the HTTPS URL and paste a valid token, or unlock the device and try again. Keystore storage must be available.
Agent requires Android 6 or later for Keystore encryption. Ordinary keyboard features remain available.
No enabled configuration. Set an HTTPS server and bearer token, then opt in. Typing does not send requests.
Agent unavailable: private/password field, incognito, locked device, or editor disconnected/changed. Nothing inserted.
Compose a prompt in the field, or select text, then tap Agent. Use 1–4000 characters. Longer text is not sent or truncated.
Send only this text to %1$s?\n\n%2$s
Send prompt
Waiting (45 second limit). Cancel leaves your field unchanged; server work may continue.\n\n%1$s

Agent busy: the previous editor request or transport cleanup has not finished. Nothing sent. Wait, then reopen Agent or Acts and confirm Send again. If the transport will not return, force-stop this app to recover. Typing is still available. No automatic retries; server work may continue even after force-stop.

Timed out after 45 seconds. Nothing inserted. A new send is blocked until the request and transport cleanup finish. Close this dialog and wait, then reopen Agent or Acts for a fresh Send confirmation. If stuck, force-stop this app. No automatic retries; server work may continue even after force-stop.

Request failed, timed out, or returned a non-success/invalid answer. Nothing inserted. Check server/token/network. Close this dialog and reopen Agent or Acts for a fresh Send confirmation. No automatic retries; server work may still be running.
Review agent result
Finish reason: %1$s. Insert after the selection/cursor? Original text will be kept. Review carefully: model output is untrusted.\n\n%2$s
Insert after selection
Full insertion could not be verified, or the editor changed. Some text may have been inserted. Check the field; Insert is disabled to prevent duplicates. You can select and copy this result:\n\n%1$s
